name: check-the-game-v2
description: "Check!" is a web-based, free-to-play online multiplayer card game. The primary goal is to have the lowest total card value in your hand at the end of a round. This project implements the card game with a Node.js/Socket.IO backend and a new, modern Next.js/React frontend.
author: Vroslmend

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared-types && concurrently -n server,client "npm run build -w server" "npm run build -w client"
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server
scripts.probe:install: cd tools/probe && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared-types/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run check:majors && npm run check:commits && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:server && npm run check:seed && npm run check:hidden && npm run check:totals && npm run build:client
